title: Reprinting a staff lunch count

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Before you reprint the lunch count, open today’s order list and exclude orders marked cancelled from the count. Yesterday one list showed sixty meals, but five of those orders had been cancelled. The kitchen made too many because it got the unrevised count. Put the word Revised next to today's date on the new copy. Take the original off the kitchen board, but keep it in the office file so we can explain the change later. The kitchen should see only the revised copy.
turns.zh: 重印午餐份數表前，先打開今天的訂單清單，把標為取消的訂單排除在份數統計之外。昨天有一份清單顯示六十份餐點，其中五筆訂單已取消。廚房收到未修訂的數量，所以多做了。請在新表的今天日期旁加註「已修訂」。請把原表從廚房看板取下，但要存入辦公室檔案，以便之後說明改了什麼。廚房看板只能留修訂版。
